name: minimal
why: Empty everything -- the degenerate row.

name: plain_right
why: The common case: a turn with a street name.

name: with_note
why: A note is appended as ' \newline \textit{...}' (latex.py:125). Note latex_tests.py:139 still expects '\textbf{Note:} \emph{...}' -- that test is stale (commit 69ee4d1 'cleaner notes').

name: note_without_description
why: When the description is blank the note REPLACES it rather than being appended (latex.py:121-123), so a note-only cue still fills the On column.

name: whitespace_only_description
why: The check is `esc_description.strip() == ''`, so a description of spaces also promotes the note.

name: for_distance_zero
why: A for_distance of exactly 0.0 is falsy, so the For column is EMPTY rather than '  0.0' (latex.py:126).

name: for_distance_none
why: No for_distance -- the last row of a sheet.

name: for_distance_rounding
why: The For column is '%5.1f', so sub-0.05 legs round to 0.0 while still being truthy.

name: distance_width
why: The At column is '%5.1f'; a 3-digit distance consumes the padding.

name: yellow_row
why: Danger and pit stops get a yellow \rowcolor.

name: gray_row
why: Right turns (and, via the missing-comma quirk, every Start/End/Generic row) get [gray]{0.8}.

name: modifier_quick
why: QUICK + RIGHT concatenates to 'QR'.

name: modifier_slight
why: SLIGHT + LEFT concatenates to 'BL'.

name: climb_glyph
why: Climb categories render as a mountain glyph.

name: summit_glyph
why: Summit shares the glyph with the label 'End'.

name: first_aid_glyph
why: First aid renders as a raised plus.

name: escaping_in_description
why: User text reaching the renderer: every LaTeX special must be neutralized before it hits pdflatex.

name: emphasis_in_description
why: Markdown-ish emphasis survives escaping and becomes real LaTeX.

name: emphasis_in_note
why: _format is applied to the note too (latex.py:130).

name: ampersand_would_break_the_table
why: A raw '&' is a column separator; unescaped it would corrupt the row.

name: percent_would_comment_the_row
why: A raw '%' would comment out the rest of the line, silently dropping the For column.

name: zwsp_in_description
why: RideWithGPS emits U+200B between joined street names; commit 2278d0d.

name: unicode_description
why: Accented Latin text.

name: custom_instruction
why: A [tag]-derived instruction renders bold in the Go column.

name: custom_instruction_with_specials
why: The tag is user-controlled, so it is escaped like any other input.

name: unmapped_uturn
why: How route 55132669's 'Uturn' type actually reaches the page.
